classes: 0 not water, 1 open water, 2 water under plants (possible, not validated), 3 not assessed (built-up), 255 no data or sea

rules.open_water: v1 U-Net ensemble p(open water) >= 0.3 (pre-registered, docs/CV_RESULTS.md)
rules.water_under_plants: candidate rule, not validated: vegetated WorldCover land, 5x5 filtered HH at least 3.0 dB above its stack median and HV within 1.5 dB of its median
rules.not_assessed: ESA WorldCover 50 built-up: the radar cannot see water between buildings at 20 m
rules.confidence: share of agreeing checks, steps of 5: model margin to 0.3; HH below -15.0 dB; coherence below 0.25; clear optical DSWx-HLS within 1 day. Class 2: the model's p(any water) only, capped at 50
rules.s1: OPERA DSWx-S1 at most 2 h from the pass: 0 not water, 1 open water, 2 inundated vegetation, 3 built-up
